levels.name: Clockwise Window
levels.hint: This guard turns every second move. Red nodes are lit now or on the guard's next look: never step onto one. WAIT to let the cone pass.

levels.name: Crossing Time
levels.hint: The patrol walks back and forth and looks where it walks. Cross its lane only when it is heading away from you.

levels.name: Locked Route
levels.hint: The door is locked. Collect the key first; the door node also blocks the guard's sight until you hold the key.

levels.name: Cloud Corridor
levels.hint: Smoke hides you for this action and the next one, but a guard walking onto your node still catches you.
